description: Agent Coordination: submit how one job is divided between the participating agents: each part of the job with its name, the other names assignments use for it, whether it is worked jointly by design and the agent that leads it, and each agent’s assignment with the parts it is told to do, the parts it is told to leave alone and the assignment as written. The signed report gives every part with the agents whose assignments cover it (owned, overlapping, jointly worked with or without a lead, or unowned), every assignment with the parts it covers, read from its list or else from the parts its statement names, and its wording (bounded, hedged or open-ended), and names territory that collides: parts two agents are told to do, parts in nobody’s assignment and assignments stated so loosely, with anything else, as needed or etc., that overlap is inevitable; then edges stated as help or support, assignments naming parts not on the job’s list, jointly worked parts with no lead and agents with no stated territory, with the fix for each. The access that travels with one handed-off task is wever_handoff-scope-check and the tasks one delegate may do for one principal are wever_delegation-scope-check. Verdict territory_collides, territory_gaps, territory_unverified or territory_clear. POST /api/coordination-boundary-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.

covers.description: The parts the agent is told to do.

excludes.description: The parts the agent is told to leave alone.

statement.description: The assignment as written, read for open-ended wording and for the parts it names.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

aliases.description: Other names assignments use for it.

lead.description: The agent that leads a part worked jointly.

name.description: A part of the job, such as the pricing page copy.

shared.description: The part is worked jointly by design.

name: wever_coordination-boundary-check
title: Coordination boundary check
